pr_body:
This PR adds the device tree binding for the Atmel SAM GMAC Ethernet and converts the existing compatible SoCs (SAM E70 and V71) and boards (`sam_e70_xplained` and `sam_v71_xult`) to use it.

Includes commits from #23055.

Fixes #22997.

https://gist.github.com/stephanosio/cc7dd2049a740bdb13b1acdf6c6325af

issue_context.title: Add GMAC device tree definition
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The Atmel GMAC (Ethernet MAC) hardware is currently not specified by the device tree.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
1. Add device tree binding for Atmel GMAC.
    * The binding shall contain the "queue count" parameter (see https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22961#discussion_r381966267)
    * Add any other hardware-specific parameters in the binding
2. Instantiate GMAC device(s) in all relevant SoCs.
    * SAM 4E
    * SAM E53
    * SAM E54
    * SAM E70
    * SAM V71
3. Update the GMAC driver to use the GMAC hardware parameters from the device tree.

review_comments: Convert this to use new DT_INST macro syntax.
